verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy question for a hosted AI app-building platform like Replit, so the axis applies. The pack contains no documentation of retention settings, deletion requests, or data-lifecycle controls. Generic mentions of SOC 2 and admin controls are adjacent security features, not retention or deletion controls, and the community report of the agent deleting a database is not about user-controlled retention.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
